name: Administrator creates linked academic structure
description: Creates linked academic records and verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Open Academic administration
Create a faculty, department, programme and course in sequence
Refresh the module and verify the records remain listed
expected: All linked academic records remain visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Administrator assigns a class representative to a course
description: Verifies an administrator assigns an account with Class Representative role to a course and the representative sees only their assigned course data.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator and assign the Class Representative role to a user
Open Class Representatives
Assign the representative to a course
Sign in as that representative and open CR Dashboard
expected: The representative sees enrolled students and attendance summaries only for assigned courses.

name: Students earn points and badges from verified attendance
description: Verifies only lecturer-verified attendance earns points and unlocks milestone badges.
steps: Sign in as a Student with a verified attendance record
Open Achievements & leaderboard
Review points, verified class count and badges
Compare the student's score with the leaderboard
expected: Each verified record contributes ten points and pending or rejected records contribute no points.

name: Student uses QR, GPS and focus policies for class attendance
description: Verifies students can check in using QR, NFC or manual code and that location and focus rules are enforced.
steps: Create a session with geofencing and a focus policy
Display the QR code and write the code to an NFC tag
Scan the QR or tap the NFC tag from a supported device
Enable focus monitoring and switch away from the browser
expected: The system validates the session code, enforces configured geofence/focus policies and records check-in for lecturer review.

name: AI Study Hub answers questions, generates quizzes and reviews engagement
description: Verifies authenticated students can ask an academic question, generate practice questions and receive a cautious engagement review based only on their recorded AFAMS signals.
steps: Sign in and open AI Study Hub
Ask the assistant an academic question
Generate a practice quiz from course notes
Run the personal engagement review
expected: The assistant returns academic guidance, the quiz contains answers and explanations, and the review distinguishes recorded facts from missing academic data.
